## New article checklist

**Target role(s):**
<!-- Which of the roles in the frontmatter, and why those? -->

**Tags:**
<!-- List them. Did you reuse existing tags from the /tags page where possible? -->

**Is this original content?**
<!--
Yes / No. If you have adapted it from a talk, blog post or internal report,
say so and confirm you have the right to publish it here. Everything merged is
released under CC BY 4.0.
-->

**Are external sources cited where appropriate?**
<!--
Yes / No / Not applicable. Any figure taken from elsewhere — especially
emissions or energy numbers — should link to where it came from.
-->

**Does this contain potentially time-sensitive information?**
<!--
Yes / No. Prices, specific tool versions, or policy under consultation all

## Before you submit

- [ ] The file is in `content/case-studies/` with a lowercase-kebab-case filename
- [ ] Frontmatter is filled in (`npm run build` passes locally, or CI is green)
- [ ] The body starts at `##` — the title comes from the frontmatter, not an `#` heading
- [ ] I am happy for this to be published under CC BY 4.0, credited to my GitHub handle
